company_profile: Leidos Holdings, Inc. — diversified defense, intel, civil and health IT prime; ~47,000 employees; 87% of revenue from U.S. government; three reportable segments: Defense Solutions (56% FY23), Civil (24%), Health (20%).
extraction_notes: LDOS is a diversified mega-prime; its 10-K describes capability areas rather than naming individual Program Elements (PEs). For J-Book-cohort scoring, we extract the capability/program-area claims and look up the corresponding PE families (Hypersonics, Directed Energy, JADC2, MHS GENESIS, Sentinel/GBSD, anti-submarine warfare, NextGen FAA ATC, etc.). Per the rubric, NOT_FOUND in our 410-PE corpus → UNVERIFIABLE (not RED).
